summary.headline: Jupiter in Saturn’s House
summary.text: Chapter 40 interprets Jupiter in Saturn’s house and in its own house, contrasting outcomes in diurnal and nocturnal nativities, including poverty, grief, secrecy, fortune, wealth, royal favor, religious affiliation, and legal or religious office. The preceding passage also associates the same configuration in Mercury’s and the Moon’s houses with scarcity, occult-book study, speech impediment, illness, and damage to the mother’s substance.
